## Vulnerabilities Fixed

### 1. SSRF - Private/Internal IP Access (Critical)
The original code only checked `http`/`https` scheme but allowed requests to any IP, including:
- `127.0.0.1`, `localhost` (loopback)
- `10.x.x.x`, `172.16-31.x.x`, `192.168.x.x` (RFC 1918 private networks)
- `169.254.169.254` (cloud metadata endpoint)
- IPv6 private/link-local ranges

**Fix**: Added `safeResolveAndCheck()` that resolves hostnames and blocks requests to all private/reserved IP ranges (both IPv4 and IPv6).

### 2. SSRF - Redirect Bypass (Critical)
The default HTTP client follows redirects, so an attacker could set up a public server that redirects to an internal IP, bypassing the initial URL validation.

**Fix**: Added a `CheckRedirect` handler that validates redirect targets against the same private IP check.
